natural_language_summary: EscapingGuard models an environment-controlled guard position in a bounded two-dimensional space. Dim is the integer range 0..7. The only variable is env guard: Dim[2]. Predicate moveDist characterizes a one-step transition where a coordinate may stay equal, increase by one, or decrease by one. The guard values are constrained by the Dim type, and both guard coordinates are constrained to satisfy moveDist on every transition.
